mapper.select: select student_id, total_points, level_no, day_streak, last_practice_date, week_points, week_start, update_time from spas_student_point_account where student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: insert into spas_student_point_account( student_id, total_points, level_no, day_streak, last_practice_date, week_points, week_start, update_time) values ( #{studentId}, coalesce(#{totalPoints}, 0), coalesce(#{levelNo}, 1), coalesce(#{dayStreak}, 0), #{lastPracticeDate}, coalesce(#{weekPoints}, 0), #{weekStart}, now()) on conflict (student_id) do update set total_points = excluded.total_points, level_no = excluded.level_no, day_streak = excluded.day_streak, last_practice_date = excluded.last_practice_date, week_points = excluded.week_points, week_start = excluded.week_start, update_time = now()

insert into spas_student_point_ledger( student_id, dept_id, subject_id, points, reason_code, ref_type, ref_id, biz_key, remark, create_time) values ( #{studentId}, #{deptId}, #{subjectId}, #{points}, #{reasonCode}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{bizKey}, #{remark}, now())
mapper.select: select ledger_id, student_id, dept_id, subject_id, points, reason_code, ref_type, ref_id, biz_key, remark, create_time from spas_student_point_ledger where biz_key = #{bizKey}
select coalesce(sum(points), 0) from spas_student_point_ledger where student_id = #{studentId} and create_time::date = #{day}::date

select count(1) from spas_practice_log where student_id = #{studentId} and subject_id = #{subjectId} and practice_date = #{practiceDate}::date and coalesce(status, '0') = '0' and (proxy_flag = '0' or confirm_status = '2')

select a.student_id, a.total_points, a.level_no, a.day_streak, a.last_practice_date, a.week_points, a.week_start, a.update_time, s.student_name, s.student_no, row_number() over (order by a.total_points desc, a.update_time asc, a.student_id) as rank_no from spas_student_point_account a join spas_student s on s.student_id = a.student_id where s.dept_id = #{deptId} and coalesce(s.status, '0') = '0' and a.total_points > 0 order by a.total_points desc, a.update_time asc, a.student_id limit #{limit}

select a.student_id, a.total_points, a.level_no, a.day_streak, a.last_practice_date, a.week_points, a.week_start, a.update_time, s.student_name, s.student_no, row_number() over (order by a.week_points desc, a.update_time asc, a.student_id) as rank_no from spas_student_point_account a join spas_student s on s.student_id = a.student_id where s.dept_id = #{deptId} and coalesce(s.status, '0') = '0' and a.week_start = #{weekStart}::date and a.week_points > 0 order by a.week_points desc, a.update_time asc, a.student_id limit #{limit}

select student_id as "studentId", knowledge_id as "knowledgeId", coalesce(avg_rate, weighted_rate, 0) as "avgRate" from spas_student_knowledge_stat where student_id in
#{id}

select distinct pk.knowledge_id from spas_practice_log p join spas_practice_log_knowledge pk on pk.log_id = p.log_id where p.student_id = #{studentId} and p.practice_date >= #{beginDate}::date and p.practice_date <= #{endDate}::date and coalesce(p.status, '0') = '0' and (p.proxy_flag = '0' or p.confirm_status = '2')
